0022600136.text: The Toronto Raptors (2-0, third in the East and second in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back) host the Orlando Magic (0-2, 12th in the East and fourth in the Southeast, 1.5 games back) in the Raptors' fourth game of the season. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation, averaging 19.5 points in 25.8 minutes this season), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Toronto won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 139-87 win in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
